==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. The rain revealed a blue Japanese castle. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.)

There I met Storm Rabbit who claimed to rule the village whenever it rained. (Storm Rabbit resembles a blue, humanoid, female rabbit dressed in regal, blue, Japanese robes decorated with shiny orange rose symbols.)

They are the Village King's rival and eventually the two will fight for full control. (Village King resembles a giant, wooden, elf man who wears a green robe with a white fur collar.)
